verdict.rationale: Martin is a SaaS personal assistant, so a documented public API is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only shows conversational interfaces (phone, SMS, WhatsApp, email, Slack, desktop) and an llms.txt docs index. No documented programmatic API appears, and all OpenAPI/Swagger probe paths returned 404. Messaging channels and an LLM-readable docs index are adjacent features, not a public API, so they earn no credit.
